title: Lock bindSessionLane/unbindSessionLane under the sessions store lock
action: Wrap bindSessionLane and unbindSessionLane (.bee/bin/lib/claims.mjs:297-319) in the same 'sessions' store lock heartbeatSession uses (acquireSessionsLock), closing the heartbeat-vs-bind lost-update race (issue #56 3.8). Add a regression test interleaving a heartbeat read-modify-write with a lane bind, asserting the binding survives. Regen inside this cell after the code change: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs; node skills/bee-hive/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply; node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write.

truths: regression test proves binding survives concurrent heartbeat

verify: node scripts/run_verify.mjs --impacted && node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --check && node scripts/ledger_parity.mjs --check

trace.outcome: bindSessionLane/unbindSessionLane now hold the sessions lock; heartbeatSession's read moved inside its own lock hold — closes the heartbeat-vs-bind/unbind lost-update race (issue #56 3.8 / D10a). Two forced-interleaving regression tests added (no sleeps/threads), red-first proven, now green.
